notes: Vendor, PO-2203 and the $1,240.00 amount all match the seeded lease, but the document carries no invoice number at all: the vendor says a numbered copy follows. expected.fields.invoice_number is null because the field is absent from the source, matching the INV-015 convention that an absent field is null rather than a placeholder string. The reference parser in packages/pipeline/src/parse.ts falls back to the literal 'UNKNOWN' when no number regex matches; 'UNKNOWN' is a parser sentinel, not an extracted value, so the golden records null. Spec 07 section 5 keys duplicate detection on vendor plus invoice_number, so a missing number makes the dedupe check unresolvable: exception_hold with a drafted request for the numbered invoice.
